sentences.text: CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA DHARI SINGH  ORDER % 10.02.2025 CRL.M.A. 3965/2025 (Exemption) Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

1. The instant bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (earlier under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) has been filed on behalf of the petitioner/applicant seeking grant of regular bail in FIR No. 0273/2019 registered at Police Station EOW Delhi for the offence punishable under Sections 406/409/420/120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
Heard.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/02/2025 at 21:30:57 3.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State appearing on advance notice accepted notice and vehemently opposed the instant application.

He prayed for four weeks' time to file the status report.
Let the same be filed within four weeks as prayed.
4.
The nominal roll of the applicant be called from the Jail Authority concerned before the next date of hearing.

5. List on 23rd April, 2025.
